notes.title: A long due update on Multiplayer and life.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

We wish to apologize for not posting an update for a while now. To be completely honest, our first child was born about a month ago (we're a couple) and so the game has been put aside lately for a bit.
We're still working on the game and the Multiplayer option is in its final stage. We still need to add some graphics and do some final testing, but it's definitely happening and we didn't neglect it.
So we're doing our best to find the time to finish the multiplayer update as we raise our child, which is a tough task :)
Rest assured - we didn't abandon the project, we're just taking a bit more time.

Also, as you noticed, we're still making bug fixed and small features and updating regularly.
We also reply to any mail or post, doing our best to support the community.

So please bare with us a little bit more :)

Thank you again for your support and concern.
Liron & Roma.

notes.title: Update: New Feature & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We've uploaded a new update that includes requested features and several bug fixes:

[h3]New Feature:[/h3]

The alchemist can now pick up mines that he placed on the ground and place them in a different location. This was a request by many so we add it just for you.
Mines count is still limited, so use them wisely.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

We fixed several bugs in the game.
Please report to us of any bugs you find, either by posting in this group under "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1174670/discussions/1/]Questions / Report Issues[/url]" or through our [url=https://discord.gg/DFDxWKQ]Discord server[/url], where you can chat with us and get online support.

[h3]Coming Next:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Archers will step aside when blocking melee units even if they are shooting arrows.
[*] Un-merged formations rework.
[*] Pause without the popup menu and with ability to control units.
[*] We'll add hidden rewards throughout the game.
[*] And of course we're working on Multiplayer :)
[/list]

notes.title: Update: New Features & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We've uploaded a new update that includes requested features and several bug fixes:

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Frame rate limit mechanism is now available under Options > Video.
[*]You can now adjust the range of unit selection with double click. This feature is available under Options > Controls.
[*]We've added Level Loading gameplay tips.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Difficulty level is now saved properly.
[*]Units behavior is now saved properly.
[*]When Freya is healing she can now go thorough idle units.
[*]Enemy units are now responding properly to win game.
[*]Reworked math for damage calculation and vetting.
[*]Fixed a bug when unit receives damage randomly.
[*]V-Sync under Windows is now fixed.
[/list]

[h3]Coming Next:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Allow Alchemist to pick up mines.
[*]Archers will step aside when blocking melee units even if they are shooting arrows.
[*]Un-merged formations rework.
[*]Pause without the popup menu and with ability to control units.
[*]We'll add hidden rewards throughout the game.
[*]And more...
[/list]

notes.title: We Have an Official Release Date
notes.notes:
We finally have an official release date, and it's June 19th, 2020 !!

We hoped it could be sooner, but we wanted to give you the best experience we can create.
The game will be released to Steam and Mac App Store.

Follow us on Social Media for more updates, sneak peaks, offers and more!
